extra_vocab.en: things you throw away because you do not need them
extra_vocab.note: 指丟棄的垃圾，是美式常用字，辦公室、飯店與公共場所的告示常看到。也可當動詞，意思是「丟掉」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: trash 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能說 a trash；要數量時用 a piece of trash。

example.en: He trashes old documents every Friday to keep his desk clean.
example.zh: 他每週五都會丟掉舊文件，讓桌面保持整潔。

example.en: The staff trashed the broken chairs before the inspection.
example.zh: 員工在檢查前把壞掉的椅子丟掉了。

example.en: Employees are trashing too much paper in our office.
example.zh: 員工在我們辦公室丟掉太多紙張了。

example.en: Please take out the trash before you leave tonight.
example.zh: 今晚離開前請把垃圾拿出去倒。

example.en: There is a trash can next to every printer.
example.zh: 每台印表機旁邊都有一個垃圾桶。

example.en: We ran out of trash bags in the kitchen.
example.zh: 廚房的垃圾袋用完了。

examples.en: Please put your paper cups in the trash after the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議結束後，請把紙杯丟進垃圾桶。

examples.en: Trash will be collected every Monday and Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 垃圾會在每週一和週四早上收取。

examples.en: The workers removed all the trash from the loading area.
examples.zh: 工人把裝卸區的垃圾全部清走了。

examples.en: I accidentally trashed the file instead of saving it.
examples.zh: 我不小心把檔案丟掉，而不是存檔。

example.en: The garbage truck arrives early on Tuesday mornings.
example.zh: 垃圾車在週二一大早就會到。

example.en: We should reduce food waste in the cafeteria.
example.zh: 我們應該減少自助餐廳的食物浪費。

example.en: Please do not leave any rubbish in the hall.
example.zh: 請不要在大廳留下任何垃圾。

example.en: Please separate the trash and the recycling.
example.zh: 請把垃圾和回收物分開。

example.en: She trashed the old brochures and ordered new ones.
example.zh: 她把舊的手冊丟掉，另外訂了新的。

extra_vocab.en: for a short time only, not forever
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常出現在公告與通知中，說明店面、服務或職務「暫時」的狀態，例如 temporarily closed、temporarily unavailable。語氣中立、客氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: temporarily 是副詞，常放在 be 動詞或助動詞之後、過去分詞之前（is temporarily closed）；要修飾名詞時用形容詞 temporary。

example.en: The museum is temporarily closed for cleaning this week.
example.zh: 博物館這週因清潔而暫時關閉。

example.en: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
example.zh: 此服務暫時無法使用，請稍後再試。

example.en: The blue model is temporarily out of stock at our store.
example.zh: 藍色款式在我們店裡暫時缺貨。

example.en: Mr. Chen is temporarily in charge while the director is away.
example.zh: 主任不在期間，陳先生暫時負責。

examples.en: Parking will be temporarily limited because of road work.
examples.zh: 因道路施工，停車將暫時受到限制。

examples.en: Ms. Lee will temporarily take over my duties next week.
examples.zh: 李小姐下週會暫時接手我的工作。

examples.en: He was temporarily moved to the Seoul office last month.
examples.zh: 他上個月被暫時調到首爾辦公室。

examples.en: The supplier temporarily raised prices because of a shortage.
examples.zh: 供應商因為短缺而暫時調高價格。

confusable.diff: temporary 是形容詞，意思也是「暫時的」，但詞性不同。
confusable.usage: temporary 修飾名詞（a temporary job），temporarily 修飾動詞或形容詞（temporarily closed）。

example.en: She accepted a temporary job in the sales department.
example.zh: 她接受了銷售部門的一份臨時工作。

example.en: The manager briefly explained the new schedule.
example.zh: 經理簡短地說明了新的時間表。

example.en: The shop has closed permanently after ten years.
example.zh: 這家店營業十年後已永久歇業。

derived.link: 字根 tempor 表示「時間」，加 -ary 變形容詞，像 primary、necessary，意思是只持續一段時間的
temporary 的縮寫，口語指短期雇用的人

extra_vocab.en: a piece of cloth or paper used to dry your hands or body
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店、健身房與辦公室的情境，例如房務送毛巾、洗手間的擦手紙巾（paper towel）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: towel 是可數名詞，單數要加 a 或 the；擦手紙巾的 paper towel 也是可數，也常用複數 paper towels。

example.en: We ordered fifty white towels for the new guest rooms.
example.zh: 我們為新客房訂了五十條白毛巾。

example.en: Guests can find a bath towel in each closet.
example.zh: 房客可以在每個衣櫃裡找到一條浴巾。

example.en: The kitchen is out of paper towels again.
example.zh: 廚房的擦手紙巾又用完了。

example.en: Please put the hand towel back after use.
example.zh: 使用後請把擦手巾放回原處。

example.en: The towel rack in Room 305 is broken.
example.zh: 305 號房的毛巾架壞了。

examples.en: Housekeeping will bring a clean towel to your room.
examples.zh: 房務人員會送一條乾淨的毛巾到您的房間。

examples.en: Each member receives a free towel at the gym.
examples.zh: 每位會員在健身房都能領到一條免費毛巾。

examples.en: Someone left a wet towel in the staff bathroom.
examples.zh: 有人把濕毛巾留在員工洗手間。

confusable.diff: tower 是高塔或大樓，發音 /ˈtaʊɚ/ 和 towel 很像，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The company office is on the top floor of the tower.
example.zh: 公司辦公室在那棟大樓的最高層。

example.en: Please put a napkin beside each plate.
example.zh: 請在每個盤子旁放一張餐巾。

example.en: There is a box of tissues on the front desk.
example.zh: 櫃檯上有一盒面紙。

example.en: Guests may ask for an extra blanket at any time.
example.zh: 房客隨時可以要求多一條毯子。

extra_vocab.en: a round red fruit that is often eaten as a vegetable
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在餐廳菜單、點餐對話與食品採購的情境，例如 tomato sauce、tomato soup。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tomato 的複數是 tomatoes（加 -es），不是 tomatos；一般泛指時多用複數。

example.en: The restaurant buys tomatoes from a local farm every week.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每週向當地農場買番茄。

example.en: The pasta comes with a rich tomato sauce.
example.zh: 這份義大利麵附濃郁的番茄醬汁。

example.en: Today's special is tomato soup with garlic bread.
example.zh: 今日特餐是番茄湯搭配蒜香麵包。

example.en: Add a few cherry tomatoes to each plate.
example.zh: 每個盤子裡加幾顆小番茄。

examples.en: Would you like tomato or lettuce on your sandwich?
examples.zh: 您的三明治要加番茄還是生菜？

examples.en: This tomato looks too soft to use in the salad.
examples.zh: 這顆番茄看起來太軟，不適合用在沙拉裡。

examples.en: Our company grows only one kind of tomato in this area.
examples.zh: 我們公司在這個地區只種一種番茄。

confusable.diff: potato 是馬鈴薯，拼法與發音都和 tomato 很像，但是是不同的食物。

example.en: The steak comes with a baked potato and a salad.
example.zh: 牛排附有烤馬鈴薯和一份沙拉。

example.en: We serve fresh vegetables at lunch every day.
example.zh: 我們每天午餐都供應新鮮蔬菜。

example.en: The store sells fresh fruit from local farms.
example.zh: 這家店販售當地農場的新鮮水果。

example.en: Fresh ingredients make our recipes taste better.
example.zh: 新鮮食材讓我們的料理更美味。

extra_vocab.en: a flat object used to carry or hold things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、機艙與辦公室情境：服務生端托盤、機上小桌板（tray table）、印表機的紙匣（paper tray）。

example.en: The cafeteria washes all the trays after each lunch period.
example.zh: 自助餐廳每個午餐時段後都會清洗所有托盤。

example.en: Refill the paper tray before you print the report.
example.zh: 列印報告前請先補充紙匣的紙張。

example.en: Use a serving tray to carry the coffee cups.
example.zh: 請用托盤端咖啡杯。

example.en: Please return your tray table to the upright position.
example.zh: 請將您的小桌板收回直立位置。

examples.en: The waiter carried a tray of drinks to the table.
examples.zh: 服務生端著一托盤飲料到桌邊。

examples.en: Please return your tray to the counter after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後請把托盤歸還到櫃檯。

examples.en: He put his keys and coins in a plastic tray at the airport.
examples.zh: 他在機場把鑰匙和硬幣放進塑膠盤裡。

confusable.diff: try 是「嘗試」，/traɪ/ 和 tray /treɪ/ 拼法、發音都很接近，但詞性與意思都不同。
confusable.usage: tray 是名詞（托盤），try 是動詞（嘗試），後面常接名詞或 to V。

example.en: Please try the soup before you return the tray.
example.zh: 請先試喝湯，再歸還托盤。

example.en: The waiter placed a clean plate on the table.
example.zh: 服務生在桌上放了一個乾淨的盤子。

example.en: This dish is made with chicken and rice.
example.zh: 這道菜是用雞肉和米飯做的。

example.en: She ordered a bowl of soup for lunch.
example.zh: 她午餐點了一碗湯。

senses.en: a flat object used to carry food and drinks

example.en: Each guest takes a tray in the cafeteria line.
example.zh: 每位客人在自助餐排隊時都會拿一個托盤。

senses.en: the part of a printer that holds paper
senses.distinguish: 出現在 printer、copier、paper 附近時，指的是放紙的紙匣。

example.en: The copier is jammed because the tray is not closed.
example.zh: 因為紙匣沒有關好，影印機卡紙了。

senses.en: a flat box on a desk for papers
senses.distinguish: 出現在 desk、forms、documents 附近時，指的是辦公桌上放文件的盤子。

example.en: Put your signed forms in the tray on my desk.
example.zh: 請把簽好的表格放在我桌上的文件盤裡。

extra_vocab.en: the act of changing words from one language to another, or the changed text
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在合約、使用手冊、網站與行銷資料需要翻成其他語言的情境，也常和翻譯服務、翻譯軟體一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「一份譯文」時可數，常用 a translation of + 文件；指「翻譯這件事」時視為不可數。

example.en: The agency provides translations in more than ten languages.
example.zh: 這家公司提供十幾種語言的翻譯。

example.en: The company uses a translation service for all its contracts.
example.zh: 這家公司的所有合約都使用翻譯服務。

example.en: Machine translation is fast, but it is not always accurate.
example.zh: 機器翻譯很快，但不一定準確。

example.en: Our team bought new translation software last month.
example.zh: 我們團隊上個月買了新的翻譯軟體。

example.en: A small translation error caused a big problem.
example.zh: 一個小小的翻譯錯誤造成了大問題。

examples.en: We need a Japanese translation of the user manual.
examples.zh: 我們需要使用手冊的日文譯本。

examples.en: Please send me the translation by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在週五下午前把譯文寄給我。

examples.en: The translation of this contract contains several serious mistakes.
examples.zh: 這份合約的譯文有幾個嚴重的錯誤。

examples.en: Our website offers a translation in six languages.
examples.zh: 我們的網站提供六種語言的翻譯。

confusable.diff: transition 是「轉變、過渡」，開頭拼法和 translation 很像，但意思無關。

example.en: The transition to the new system took about two weeks.
example.zh: 轉換到新系統大約花了兩週。

confusable.diff: transaction 是「交易」，常和銀行、付款有關，和語言翻譯無關。

example.en: The bank recorded every transaction made on the account.
example.zh: 銀行記錄了這個帳戶的每一筆交易。

example.en: The interpreter helped us talk with the client.
example.zh: 口譯員協助我們與客戶溝通。

example.en: Her interpretation of the report was very clear.
example.zh: 她對這份報告的解讀非常清楚。

example.en: The English version of the guide is ready.
example.zh: 指南的英文版已經準備好了。

derived.link: trans-（跨越）+ late（帶），把意思從一種語言帶到另一種語言

senses.en: the act of changing words into another language

example.en: Translation of the full contract will take three days.
example.zh: 整份合約的翻譯需要三天。

senses.en: a text that has been changed into another language
senses.distinguish: 常說 a translation of … 或 check the translation，指的是已完成的成品。

example.en: Could you check this translation before we send it out?
example.zh: 寄出前，可以請你檢查這份譯文嗎？

extra_vocab.en: a long passage built under the ground or through a mountain
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於交通公告、工程新聞與出差途中，例如隧道封閉、隧道施工或火車穿過隧道。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: in the tunnel 是「在隧道裡」，through the tunnel 是「穿過隧道」，介系詞不要混用。

example.en: The city has built three tunnels under the mountain.
example.zh: 這座城市在山底下蓋了三條隧道。

example.en: Tunnel construction will start early next year.
example.zh: 隧道工程將在明年初開始。

example.en: A subway tunnel runs under the river.
example.zh: 有一條地鐵隧道穿過河底。

example.en: The train goes through a tunnel before the next stop.
example.zh: 火車在下一站之前會穿過一條隧道。

examples.en: The new tunnel will cut the trip by twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 新隧道將讓行程縮短二十分鐘。

examples.en: The tunnel will be closed overnight for safety checks.
examples.zh: 隧道夜間將封閉，進行安全檢查。

examples.en: The company won a contract to dig the tunnel.
examples.zh: 這家公司拿到了挖掘隧道的合約。

examples.en: Our bus was stuck in the tunnel for an hour.
examples.zh: 我們的巴士在隧道裡卡了一個小時。

confusable.diff: channel 是頻道、管道或海峽，拼法與發音和 tunnel 相近，但不是穿過山或地下的通道。

example.en: Trucks use the tunnel, while ships use the channel.
example.zh: 卡車走隧道，船隻則走海峽。

example.en: The bridge will close for repairs on Sunday.
example.zh: 這座橋週日會因維修而封閉。

example.en: The road to the factory is under repair.
example.zh: 通往工廠的道路正在維修。

example.en: Take the highway to reach the airport faster.
example.zh: 走公路可以更快到達機場。

extra_vocab.en: when one company buys or takes control of another company
extra_vocab.note: 多半出現在商業新聞與公司公告，指一家公司買下另一家並取得經營權；也可指接手職務或專案。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: takeover 是名詞；動詞要分開寫成 take over（took over），例如 The firm took over the shop。

example.en: Several takeovers in the industry changed the market this year.
example.zh: 今年業界的幾起收購改變了市場。

example.en: Management fought a hostile takeover by a larger rival.
example.zh: 管理階層抵抗較大競爭對手的惡意收購。

example.en: The firm made a takeover bid for its competitor.
example.zh: 這家公司對其競爭對手提出了收購出價。

example.en: Takeover talks between the two firms began last week.
example.zh: 兩家公司之間的收購談判上週開始了。

examples.en: The takeover was announced in a press release this morning.
examples.zh: 這項收購今天早上透過新聞稿發布。

examples.en: Employees were worried about the takeover of their company.
examples.zh: 員工很擔心公司被收購。

examples.en: After the takeover, the new owner kept all current staff.
examples.zh: 收購之後，新老闆留用了所有現有員工。

confusable.diff: turnover 是「營業額」或「人員流動率」，拼法和 takeover 只差第一個字母群，但意思不同。

example.en: High staff turnover makes it hard to train new workers.
example.zh: 員工流動率高，使得訓練新人很困難。

example.en: The merger created the largest bank in the region.
example.zh: 這項合併創造出區域內最大的銀行。

example.en: The acquisition of the small firm was completed in May.
example.zh: 這家小公司的收購案在五月完成。

example.en: The managers arranged a buyout of the company.
example.zh: 經理們安排了買下公司的計畫。

senses.en: when a company buys another company to control it

example.en: The takeover gave the larger firm control of the brand.
example.zh: 這項收購讓較大的公司取得了該品牌的控制權。

senses.en: when a person or team starts to be in charge of something
senses.distinguish: 出現在 project、team、duties 附近時，指的是接手工作，而不是買下公司。

example.en: The takeover of the project by a new team went smoothly.
example.zh: 新團隊接手這個專案的過程很順利。
